final: WITH album_counts AS (SELECT AlbumId, COUNT(*) as total_track_count FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), album_bytes_millis AS (SELECT AlbumId, SUM(CAST(Bytes as FLOAT)) as total_bytes, SUM(Milliseconds) as total_millis FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY AlbumId), album_stats AS (SELECT ac.total_track_count, abm.total_bytes / abm.total_millis as rate FROM album_counts ac LEFT JOIN album_bytes_millis abm ON ac.AlbumId = abm.AlbumId WHERE abm.total_bytes IS NOT NULL), mean_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) as mean_rate FROM album_stats) SELECT AVG(rate) as avg_rate, AVG(total_track_count) as avg_track_count, AVG(rate - (SELECT mean_rate FROM mean_rate)) as avg_excess FROM album_stats WHERE rate > (SELECT mean_rate FROM mean_rate)
